The '''Deep Caverns''' is a location focused on {{Skill|Mining}}. The players requires {{Skill|Mining|V}} to enter. Several unique resources can be found: {{Item|Lapis Lazuli}}, {{Item|Redstone Dust}}, {{Item|Emerald}}s, {{Item|Diamond}}s, and {{Item|Obsidian}}.

{{ZoneText
|Talk to the Lift Operator.
|Mine valuable ores.
|Watch out for mobs!
}}

== Purpose ==
The '''Deep Caverns''' are divided into {{Green|6}} layers (excluding the [[Dwarven Mines]]) that become progressively more dangerous the deeper traveled.

After discovering a layer for the first time, the player can be quickly travel to them with the {{NPCSprite|Lift Operator}}.

Each layer has its own resources and its own hostile mobs that increase in difficulty as the player progresses deeper into the caverns.

== Trivia ==
* The transition sections between levels does not spawn mobs from either floor and prevents them from entering said sections.
**This can be exploited, as the transition between the {{zone|Diamond Reserve}} and {{zone|Obsidian Sanctuary}} allows players to easily and safely mine high quantities of {{Item|Diamond}}s.
